_comment: The sky lyrics' typeface: Inter Display SemiBold (SIL OFL 1.1, see
inter-OFL.txt), subset to Latin, Greek and Cyrillic. Drawn small and
scaled up in the world, so it is rasterised at a high oversample.
What it has no glyph for falls through to Minecraft's own font and to
Unifont, so Arabic, Chinese or Japanese lines still show.
